name: 经营海报
description: Generate mobile business calendars and monthly reports from Zhihuiji data.
description_zh: 读取智慧记真实经营数据，生成手机端经营日历、三页经营月报，并支持从月报继续查询客户欠款和导出对账单。
description_en: Generate mobile business calendars and three-page monthly reports from Zhihuiji data, then continue into customer debt lookup and statement export.
examples_zh: 生成本月三页经营月报
查询月报里欠款最多的客户并导出本月对账单PDF
examples_en: Generate this month's three-page business report
Find the top debtor from the report and export this month's statement PDF
